segments.sn14.14:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dhātusova [dhātuso (sī. pī.) ayañca paṭhamārambhavākyeyeva, na sabbattha. tīsu pana addhāsu ca upamāsaṃsandananigamanaṭṭhāne ca idaṃ pāṭhanānattaṃ natthi], bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.14:2.1: “Atītampi kho [khosaddo sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi], bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova [īdisesu ṭhānesu pāṭhanānattaṃ natthi] sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.
segments.sn14.14:3.1: “Anāgatampi kho [khosaddo sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi], bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova [īdisesu ṭhānesu pāṭhanānattaṃ natthi] sattā saṃsandissanti samessanti.
segments.sn14.14:4.1: “Etarahipi kho [khosaddo sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi], bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova [īdisesu ṭhānesu pāṭhanānattaṃ natthi] sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
